record.scope: Full independent mathematical read of HEP1–HEP12, direct TCoreEig/OrdChar/psEig/IsUniv/Out contract comparison, and actual JRP15 consumer compatibility.
checks: HEP1: ASP2 uniform adic norm bound converts original evaluated coefficient continuity; the unit topology uses continuity of value and inverse; fixed iota is never assumed complex-topology continuous.

HEP2: dual-number multiplicativity proves natural linearity of trace; finite formal truncations give Newton identities for arbitrary characteristic-zero scalar algebras. Division by positive integers occurs only after evaluation in Qbar_l. The claim proves full determinant-law equality, not merely equal traces.

HEP3: nonzero spherical eigenvector identifies every coefficient including degree0 and the j+1 index; inverse Frobenius density is precisely the original H.Ax field. IsUniv and actual part Frobenius polynomials agree through the same iota.

HEP4: Norm/local reciprocity gives epsilon(s)=q^deg(s) algPow(1)(a(s)); geometric Artin has ord(a(s))=-deg(s). The extension from units to uniformizers retains the correct norm factor and original local Artin map.

HEP5–6: nonzero ordered partial products recover each individual character in source index order. q^(-i) in psEig cancels the uniformizer cyclotomic factor. Smoothness, continuity and the full OnArt quantifier match literal OrdChar.
HEP7: exact TCoreEig conjunction compared directly at source declaration189 onwards; no new arithmetic, good, domain or nonzero ordinary-module hypotheses are added.

HEP8: AFS19(3) literally supplies an eigenvector in the original part at depth c0 for every admitted arithmetic point; ASP13 supplies the actual specialization. Representation selected before the good guard.

HEP9: distinct unit restrictions exclude all norm linkages. Original PS includes twist (n-1)/2, canceled by algNorm, yielding sum omega_i composed with the same Artin map. Commutator polynomial is (X-1)^n, preserving the source AbW/AtLT test and every DRat bridge.

HEP10: dominance with reversed indices makes htW strictly increasing, and OFL16 is applied to the actual local representation and individually labeled evaluated characters. Full flag and potential crystallinity remain guarded by Good; all arithmetic points still receive continuity, semisimplicity, P and determinant.
HEP11: exact three fields of Out compared directly, including separation for every admitted dense weight and all arithmetic points, not only the initially supplied zero weight.
HEP12: FNL16, UPA17 and AFS5 install original UnitaryPointProperties on the identical hset,T,D,psi,K and fixed iota; form and all Teichmuller types are precisely the data consumed by JRP15.
not_claimed: new class field theory or period comparison foundations

checks: HEP1 uses the original ASP2 adic estimate to obtain continuity into Qbar_l, including units and the same cyclotomic character.
HEP2 gives a full polynomial-law proof: dual-number trace linearity and natural Newton identities over every characteristic-zero scalar algebra. Integer division occurs only after Qbar_l evaluation.
HEP3 checks degree j+1 versus natural spherical index0, the a_zero case, exact geometric Frobenius inverse and H.Ax dense set.

HEP4–6 preserve full local Artin identity at every Weil degree, original finite-part inverse, lowVal, psEig q^(-i), and ordered telescoping; original local-idele/class-field foundations remain explicit.
HEP7 matches the entire TCoreEig conjunction, with no added arithmetic, good, domain or flatness premise.
HEP8 checked directly against AFS19(3): nonzero eigenvector at literal depth c0 for each supplied point, same part representation chosen before goodness.
HEP9 applies exactly the distinct-unit principal-series case of GUA2 and the atL AbW test on the original Artin map.

HEP10 dominance gives the original increasing htW order; full determinant/property at every admitted arithmetic point, HasFlag/PotCrys only under the original Good guard, all bridges and prime3 preserved.
HEP11 all three Out fields univ/sep/pt keep their quantifiers, including every dense admitted weight.
HEP12 installs original UPA17/FNL16/AFS5 inputs into the same T,D,psi and fixed coefficient maps; does not assert later Hida pt or all-level automorphy.
